quality.review_scope: Accepted independent quick audit of all seven main pages, named colloid, AC/HOPG 5 W and 10 W regions, and Figures 1–4; SI and cited upstream methods were not reviewed.
missing_fields: Absolute volumes and percentage basis of both reverse-micelle stock preparations.
Hydrazine stock volume; dodecanethiol dose and capping time.
Ethanol wash count/volume, size-selection method/fractions and colloid yield (prior procedure cited but not read).
Plasma temperature/thermal profile; whether [nanocrystals] molarity counts particles or Ag units.
Dodecane comparison preparation, plasma conditions and direct figure assignment.
conflicts: The paper calls coalesced objects pure Ag after EELS, while saying substrate oxygen prevents a lower bound on oxide content; present both without a zero-oxide claim.
